picks.rationale: Freshest and most actionable pick: two dueling new surveys on AI audiobook narration - a Spoken study found 61% of listeners mistook AI voices for human and favored them in multi-character scenes, while an Audio Publishers Association study shows willingness to try AI narration fell from 70% (2025) to 61% (2026). Concrete new data point (multi-cast AI voices) that changes how audiobook producers weigh AI narration; distinct survey/angle from the published anu-audiobook usage report (7/13) and the cartland-clone voice-cloning story (7/11).
picks.excerpt: Two dueling surveys on AI audiobook narration: a Spoken-commissioned study found 61% of listeners mistook AI voices for human and favored them in multi-character scenes, while an Audio Publishers Association study shows willingness to try AI narration fell from 70% (2025) to 61% (2026) - human narration still preferred.

picks.rationale: Concrete, actionable AI tool release: Amazon expanded Kindle Translate, its free AI translation service for KDP indie authors, from two language pairs to six languages (EN, ES, DE, FR, IT, PT), with in-tool formatting, pricing, publishing and automatic accuracy checks. Directly changes how self-pub authors localize and reach global readers. Distinct outlet and distinct topic from the published goodereader kindle-recaps (AI plot summary) and kobo-h2-roadmap, and from Ailaysa's translation AI (ipa-innovation).
picks.excerpt: Amazon has expanded Kindle Translate, its free AI-powered translation service for KDP indie authors, from two language pairs to six languages - English, Spanish, German, French, Italian and Portuguese. Authors can create, manage, price and publish fully formatted machine-translated editions of their books in a few clicks, with automatic accuracy checks before publication.

picks.excerpt: At the 35th IPA Congress in Kuala Lumpur, three sessions on children's publishing argued that format and quality of content - not AI itself - shape how digital-native kids read, and pressed publishers on closing a widening global literacy gap.
